name: plmail-e2e
description: End-to-end tests for plMail (Playwright). Separate from the app's AssetMapper/importmap frontend.

scripts.test:unit:docker: docker compose -f compose.test.yaml run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint docker-php-entrypoint app php vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test:e2e:docker: npm run test:env:up && E2E_DOCKER=1 playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:docker:ui: npm run test:env:up && E2E_DOCKER=1 playwright test --ui
scripts.test:e2e:coverage: rm -rf var/js-coverage && E2E_DOCKER=1 E2E_JS_COVERAGE=1 playwright test && node bin/js-coverage.mjs
